abandoned.what: Provenance line stamping the last commit touching corpus/, record/, spec/
abandoned.why: Codex showed it is broken for the mandated rebuild-then-commit workflow: at generation time the corpus change is still uncommitted, so the page names a stale record commit and the next rebuild diffs again. Track B independently proposed the same fix; it was rejected for the same reason. Replaced by a content digest over the generator's actual inputs.

abandoned.what: Machine-readable front-matter under each deficiency heading
abandoned.why: Codex: adjacency does not validate semantics, and it would add a fourth independently-authored summary to a document that already had three disagreeing counts. Superseded by a structured register artifact, still to be built.

abandoned.what: Deterministic sanitisation of session-log free text, as T-08's brief specified
abandoned.why: Not coherent as a security guarantee. A regex denylist is an unvalidated classifier (D-25) whose errors are asymmetric -- a false negative leaks permanently, a false positive erases adverse evidence -- and no tool can distinguish 'nothing withheld' from 'silently omitted'. The renderer emits only typed values instead, and the trust boundary moves to custodian review before push.

abandoned.what: Running tools/rebuild.py inside the shared main checkout
abandoned.why: It rewrote docs/index.html underneath Track B, which was live in that working tree. No work was lost -- their checkout restored it -- but branch checkout is global state, so HANDOFF section 3's 'shared, but by branch' is unachievable with one worktree. Moved to an isolated git worktree.

abandoned.what: Committing without gating on the validator I had just run
abandoned.why: The label-length check ran as its own command and the commit chain began fresh afterwards, so an assertion failure printed a traceback and the commit proceeded. Four label descriptions over GitHub's 100-character limit shipped in d64e0e0, fixed in f58cb2a. Same shape as D-29 -- a check that exists, runs, gives the right answer, and is not reached by the path that decides anything.

narrative:
This window is dominated by two defects found in Track A's own territory before any of Track A's assigned work began, and by a third found in the maintenance path by an external reviewer.

The order of work departs from HANDOFF's instruction to do T-08 first. That departure is deliberate and is recorded here rather than left to be inferred: D-29 made every integrity claim in the repository unenforced, and the provenance defect broke the rebuild-then-commit gate that every track is told to rely on. Both were live and public. T-08 followed immediately and is in this same window.

What is NOT done is stated in record/tasks/T03-oagf-github-presence.md rather than here.
